name: Westbrook Garrison
summary: At Westbrook Garrison, Deputy Rainer's few guards hold Elwynn's western road against gnolls and bandits. The outpost is short on soldiers and supplies, with danger rising near the Westfall border.

sections.title: A Beleaguered Border Post
sections.body: Westbrook Garrison watches the road where Elwynn Forest thins toward Westfall. Deputy Rainer and a handful of guards patrol the western roads with too few soldiers to cover them. Much of the Stormwind Army serves abroad, while political indecision in the capital leaves the outpost without needed support. Thieves grow bolder, and Riverpaw gnolls have overrun the southern woods. Marshal Dughan in Goldshire has not sent formal reinforcements, so the guards depend on travelers to help secure the highway.

sections.title: The Menace of Forest's Edge
sections.body: Riverpaw gnolls gather south of Forest's Edge, where their raids threaten supply lines and homesteads. The packs follow Hogger, a fearsome chieftain whose forces outnumber the garrison and overwhelm its guards with brute strength. A high bounty is posted across the outpost, seeking fighters willing to enter the hills and bring down Hogger before the gnolls press farther east.

faq.q: Why is Westbrook Garrison so understaffed?
faq.answer: Most of the Stormwind Army serves abroad, while indecision among the House of Nobles in the capital has left regional garrisons short of soldiers and supplies. Westbrook's commanders depend on wandering adventurers to help fill the gap.

faq.q: Who is in command at the garrison?
faq.answer: Deputy Rainer oversees Westbrook Garrison and answers to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire. His requests for more soldiers have largely gone unanswered.

faq.q: What threats does the garrison face?
faq.answer: Westbrook faces bandits from Westfall and Riverpaw gnolls camping in the surrounding woods. The gnolls follow their chieftain, Hogger.

faq.q: What is the relation between Westbrook and Westfall?
faq.answer: Westbrook Garrison is Elwynn's last outpost on the western road before the bridge into Westfall. Its guards watch the border as lawlessness rises from the west.

angles.text: As a Warrior, you can help Westbrook's overstretched guards hold back wilderness predators and fight the gnoll war bands.
As an Alliance champion traveling from Elwynn toward Westfall, you can help secure Westbrook's perimeter and claim the bounty on Hogger to guard the kingdom's western border.
